deckTitle: Disease Timeline Wrestling: The Temporal Tide

cards.power: [OCR unclear — The Mainframe implied]
cards.gradeReason: Onset-in-seconds reads as category label, not wrestler identity. Needs the scenario.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: lightning bolt anatomy. Subject: stopwatch exploding with cardiac sparks. Mood: zero-warning shock.

cards.power: Depletes Baseline-Reserves, changing the arena rules.
cards.lore: Body remodels to survive but the remodel becomes a Structural-Weakness.
cards.gradeReason: Chronic remodel as slow sabotage lands at table, but needs contrast with Hyper-Acute cards.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: slow-grind industrial. Subject: bunny wrestler in rusted armor, joints visibly stiff. Mood: grinding inevitability.

cards.lore: Prodromal-Phase, forcing the Differential-Engine to work harder.
cards.gradeReason: No wrestler identity extracted. Prodromal-Phase lore describes, doesn't invite performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: detective noir meets medicine. Subject: shadow figure lurking in diagnostic fog. Mood: ambiguous dread.

cards.power: Turbo-boosts damage, skipping straight to the Final-Bell.
cards.lore: Total collapse of Compensatory-Mechanisms, Exponential failure speed.
cards.gradeReason: Turbo-boosts to Final-Bell is visceral. Card name unreadable via OCR — identity unclear.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: nitro fuel explosion. Subject: bunny wrestler injecting rocket fuel into chronic patient. Mood: catastrophic acceleration.

cards.power: The Second-Chance. The Wrestler-Frame can return to 100% health.
cards.lore: Cellular-Stress before Cellular-Death. Engines are struggling but not broken.
cards.gradeReason: Rita IS the window. You embody hope before the point of no return — immediately actionable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: glowing emergency portal. Subject: bunny wrestler pulling teammate back from cliff edge. Mood: urgent hope.

cards.power: The Permanent-Debuff. Damage cannot be undone, only contained.
cards.lore: Fibro-Fiona replaces dead tissue with Biological-Cement. Function is lost forever.
cards.gradeReason: You ARE the scar. Biological-Cement sealing function — perfect, zero explanation needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: concrete brutalism. Subject: bunny wrestler sealed in grey cement armor, immovable. Mood: finality.

cards.power: The Hidden-Hurt. Over-revving intact systems to hide the Stat-Drop.
cards.lore: Spending future reserves to survive today.
cards.gradeReason: Masking a drop by burning reserves — clear metaphor, needs one line of setup at table.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: carnival disguise. Subject: bunny wrestler in smiling mask hiding crumbling interior. Mood: deceptive fragility.

cards.power: The Pressure-Cooker. Doomsday-Clock triggers Irreversible-Ira if missed.
cards.lore: Time-sensitivity of Ischemic-Tissue. Oxygen-Debt accumulates, interest rate climbing.
cards.gradeReason: Gabe IS the ticking clock. Doomsday-Clock + Irreversible-Ira named — the stakes are the card.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: countdown bomb meets OR table. Subject: golden hourglass cracking with tissue inside. Mood: electric urgency.

cards.power: The Smoke-Signal. The Immune-Army mobilises; Arena-Temperature rises.
cards.lore: General systemic inflammation. Pre-warning of a breach.
cards.gradeReason: Spark before storm. Immune-Army mobilising is immediate body-knowledge — no setup needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: match-strike moment. Subject: bunny wrestler igniting tiny flame, crowd watching nervously. Mood: ominous calm before chaos.

cards.power: The Organ-Invasion. Pipes leak; Lactate-Debt climbs.
cards.lore: Dysregulated host response. Immune-Army damages the Arena hunting the enemy.
cards.gradeReason: Storm hits the arena, friendly fire included. You feel the dysregulation. Pure performer.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: hurricane inside a body. Subject: immune soldiers destroying own arena in chaos. Mood: catastrophic friendly fire.

cards.power: Pressure-Crash. Vessel-Pipes lose grip; Fluid-Tokens fail to hold pressure.
cards.lore: Macro/micro-circulatory failure. Oxygen-Trucks can't drive without pressure.
cards.gradeReason: The stumble IS the shock. Vessel-Pipes losing grip and trucks parking — you feel the drop.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: pressure gauge shattering. Subject: bunny wrestler collapsing mid-match, pipes bursting. Mood: systemic loss of control.

cards.power: The Domino-Effect. Kidney-Filters fail, Lung-Balloons pop, Liver-Factory shuts down.
cards.lore: Terminal phase. Arena becomes Incompatible with Life.
cards.gradeReason: Three organ systems named, dominos falling. You embody multi-organ failure without a briefing.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: factory catastrophe. Subject: three-organ domino chain collapsing in industrial arena. Mood: terminal inevitability.

cards.power: The Looming-Shadow. Enemies gather at the gates for the Remodelling-Riot.
cards.lore: Prevention phase. Deploy Lisino-the-Pril to stop the Timeline before it starts.
cards.gradeReason: Looming-Shadow captures pre-disease threat. Needs HF staging context to deploy correctly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: storm on horizon. Subject: bunny wrestler watching distant enemy army gather. Mood: quiet before escalation.

cards.power: The Shape-Shift. Heart thickens or stretches to handle High-Pressure.
cards.lore: Sarcomere-Soldiers added in parallel/series. Engine-Architecture is compromised.
cards.gradeReason: Shape-Shift as survival adaptation is clear, but Sarcomere-Soldiers needs anatomy frame.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: architectural remodel. Subject: bunny wrestler's heart growing armour plates under pressure. Mood: strained adaptation.

cards.power: The Fluid-Backlog. Return-Flow overflows the pump; Leg-Puddles and Lung-Balloons Fill.
cards.lore: Frank-Starling-Limit reached. Pushing engine causes pure Back-Pressure.
cards.gradeReason: Leg-Puddles and Lung-Balloons — visceral, visual, you know exactly what to embody.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: flood disaster. Subject: bunny wrestler drowning in fluid, balloons filling chest. Mood: desperate overflow.

cards.power: The Final-Sputter. Engine is too scarred to flicker. Pressor-Pumps fail.
cards.lore: Requires Transplant-Trade or Mechanical-Pump-VAD to continue the match.
cards.gradeReason: Final-Sputter is evocative. Transplant-Trade as game mechanic is clever but needs framing.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: dying engine room. Subject: bunny wrestler's heart as rusted sputtering pump, VAD wires attached. Mood: last gasp.

cards.power: The Loser-Knot blocks then dissolves; Warring starts.
cards.lore: Transient ischemia without Ira-the-Irreversible damage. Best chance to prevent a Stroke.
cards.gradeReason: Ghost-Stroke is inspired naming. Near-Miss needs the TIA backstory to feel like action.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: ghost doubles in the ring. Subject: phantom wrestler flickering in and out of existence. Mood: hauntingly close.

cards.power: The Tipping-Point. Deploy Alteplase-the-Clot-Melt NOW.
cards.lore: The Tipping-Point. Deploy Alteplase-the-Clot-Melt NOW or lose the Penumbra.
cards.gradeReason: Pleading penumbra is emotionally vivid. Alteplase naming lands with med audience, opaque otherwise.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: desperate zone mapping. Subject: neurons in twilight zone reaching for oxygen torch. Mood: razor-edge survival.

cards.power: The Rapid-Eraser. Every minute deletes a thousand playbook tokens.
cards.lore: Hyper-Acute neuro-time. There is no Wait-and-See in the Brain-Bunker.
cards.gradeReason: Every minute deletes tokens — no setup needed. The most urgent four words in medicine, weaponized.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: countdown clock over neuron map. Subject: bunny wrestler erasing brain tokens with each tick. Mood: electrifying urgency.

cards.power: The Long-Repair. Rewiring Brain-Cables to bypass Ira-the-Scar zones.
cards.lore: The damage is permanent, but the Arena adapts to work around it.
cards.gradeReason: Rewiring around Ira's scars — hopeful post-acute arc. Needs stroke phase context to sequence correctly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: neural rewiring diagram. Subject: bunny wrestler laying new cable routes around grey scar tissue. Mood: slow determined hope.

cards.power: The Rumour-of-Rebellion. Cells ignore the Manuals but remain in the Basement-Membrane-Fortress.
cards.lore: Pre-Malignant-Window. The optimal strike time for the Blade-Brigade.
cards.gradeReason: Rumour-of-Rebellion is a perfect pre-cancer metaphor. Basement-Membrane-Fortress needs oncology frame.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: underground resistance. Subject: rogue cells whispering in fortress basement, not yet breached. Mood: conspiratorial tension.

cards.power: The Exponential-Threat. A Fast-Clock tumor outpaces a Slow-Clock elder.
cards.lore: Mitotic-Rate. Burkitt-the-Swift doubles in 24 hours; others take months.
cards.gradeReason: Doubling time is a data point, not a wrestling move. Burkitt-the-Swift is the character here.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: time-lapse cell division. Subject: tumor mass doubling rapidly on scoreboard. Mood: exponential dread.

cards.power: The Cease-Fire. Chemo-Artillery forces Enemy-Code to hide.
cards.lore: Not a Cure. A Timeline Pause to rebuild the Health-Bar while Enemy-Code lurks.
cards.gradeReason: Cease-Fire as pause not victory is clinically sharp. Needs chemo context to understand the lurking.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: false armistice. Subject: enemy cells hiding underground while white flag flies above. Mood: uneasy temporary peace.

cards.power: The Odds-of-the-End. The Probability Story based on thousands of previous matches.
cards.lore: Population-level Time-Dynamics for Attending-Coach Long-Term Strategy.
cards.gradeReason: Population statistics in a card game. Clever concept but pure data delivery — no body to inhabit.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: survival curve graph as scoreboard. Subject: bunny coach reading Kaplan-Meier odds board. Mood: cold statistical calculation.

cards.power: The Clean-Up-Crew. Stops the bleeding and Burns-the-Trash (Bacteria).
cards.lore: Hemostasis & Inflammation. The arena must be sanitized before Rebuilders enter.
cards.gradeReason: Clean-Up-Crew burning trash before builders arrive — immediate, embodiable, no briefing needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: hazmat cleanup crew. Subject: neutrophil bunnies in orange suits burning bacterial debris. Mood: controlled urgent sanitation.

cards.power: The Reconstruction. Fiona-the-Fibroblast installs New-Pipes and Tissue-Carpets.
cards.lore: Granulation-Tissue. Temporary-Patch: soft, red, and highly vascular.
cards.gradeReason: Fiona-the-Fibroblast laying Tissue-Carpets — a named character doing a clear job. G1 by character alone.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: construction site in flesh. Subject: fibroblast bunny laying red vascular carpet over wound. Mood: busy purposeful rebuilding.

cards.power: The Strengthening. Temporary-Patch replaced by Strong-Collagen-Armor.
cards.lore: Type III collagen replaced by Type I. Gains 80% original strength, never 100%.
cards.gradeReason: 80% — never 100% is a devastating and memorable medical truth. Collagen typing needs brief context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: armour forging. Subject: wound site upgraded from soft red patch to grey collagen plate. Mood: gradual but incomplete triumph.

cards.power: The Endless-Repair. Clean-Up-Crew stays too long; Builders never finish.
cards.lore: Low-Perfusion-Flow or Sugar-Glitch-Diabetes causes a Looped Timeline.
cards.gradeReason: Looped Timeline is a great concept. Needs Sugar-Glitch-Diabetes or ischaemia context to land.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Sisyphean loop. Subject: neutrophil crew endlessly cleaning the same wound, never calling builders. Mood: trapped futility.

cards.power: The Future-Shield. Played before the Timeline starts to prevent the First-Strike.
cards.lore: The ultimate Cheat-Code that stops the match before the bell rings.
cards.gradeReason: Stopping the match before the bell is a clever frame. Needs disease context to know what to prevent.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: pre-emptive force field. Subject: bunny wrestler erecting shield before any opponent appears. Mood: confident prevention.

cards.power: The Tactical-Strike. The highest Value-Token return for the Intervention-Move.
cards.lore: Early-Intervention turns a Chronic-Chris future into a Rita-the-Reversible win.
cards.gradeReason: Chronic-Chris to Rita-the-Reversible is great cross-card storytelling. Stakes clear, timing abstract.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: precision strike target. Subject: bunny wrestler hitting timeline sweet-spot bullseye. Mood: satisfying precision.

cards.power: The Hail-Mary. Trying to save the Wrestler-Frame after Major-Damage occurred.
cards.lore: Too-Little-Too-Late. Goal shifts to Damage-Control, not Cure.
cards.gradeReason: Hail-Mary is universally understood. Damage-Control pivot is clinically resonant with med audience.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: desperation play. Subject: bunny doctor throwing last treatment at crumbling wrestler. Mood: desperate last resort.

cards.power: The Stop-Order. More Treatment-Cards only cause Pain-Tokens without helping.
cards.lore: Recognizing the Timeline has reached its Natural-End.
cards.gradeReason: Pain-Tokens without helping is devastating truth. Stop-Order as palliative pivot is brave card design.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: final bell solemnity. Subject: referee bunny stopping match, corner throwing in towel. Mood: dignified inevitability.

cards.power: The Instant-Level. Pours a bucket to start the fight bypassing slow accumulation.
cards.lore: Used for Vanco-the-Vault or Digo-the-Fox.
cards.gradeReason: Pouring bucket to skip queue is clear. Vanco-the-Vault and Digo-the-Fox land with med audience only.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: racing start line. Subject: bunny pharmacist pouring huge drug bucket at fight start. Mood: immediate power surge.

cards.power: The Disappearing-Act. Dictates when the Buff/Shield must be Refreshed.
cards.lore: Determines Dosing-Frequency. Fast Faders need pills every few hours.
cards.gradeReason: Disappearing-Act naming is solid. Fast Fader / slow fader distinction lands with any player.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: slow fade magic trick. Subject: drug molecule bunny vanishing with each half-life tick. Mood: predictable diminishment.

cards.power: The Consistent-Power. Stable blood-levels provide constant support.
cards.lore: The Equilibrium Timeline-Goal for chronic meds like Sertrali-the-Mood-Lifter.
cards.gradeReason: Equilibrium as a state to maintain, not perform. Sertrali-the-Mood-Lifter is charming but passive card.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: pharmacokinetic balance scale. Subject: drug input equals output on perfect scale, flat line behind. Mood: serene equilibrium.

cards.power: The Toxicity-Watch. Checking the Tank-Bottom to prevent poisoning the Kidney-Filters.
cards.lore: Ensures the Chemical-Ally stays in the Therapeutic-Window.
cards.gradeReason: Kidney-Filters poisoning is visceral. Therapeutic-Window framing makes the safety check meaningful.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: level gauge monitoring. Subject: bunny nurse checking drug tank bottom before refill. Mood: careful watchfulness.

cards.power: The Hidden-Enemy. Wrestler vitals are normal.
cards.lore: Multiplying-in-the-Shadows, preparing for the attack.
cards.gradeReason: Hidden-Enemy while vitals look normal — perfect silent threat embodiment. Zero setup needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: shadow multiplication. Subject: pathogen bunnies multiplying silently in dark while host sleeps. Mood: ominous quiet.

cards.power: The Fog-of-War. Wrestler is sick-ish, but the Name-Tag is hidden from the Differential-Engine.
cards.lore: First Systemic-Riot signals. Body knows it's under attack, but not where.
cards.gradeReason: Fog-of-War with hidden Name-Tag is inspired. Differential-Engine context needed to deploy.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: foggy battlefield. Subject: bunny wrestler sick-ish, enemy name tag obscured in mist. Mood: disorienting ambiguity.

cards.power: The Secret-Spreader. Kept the Pathogen-Pak to infect others.
cards.lore: Persistent colonization. The Timeline doesn't end; goes Underground.
cards.gradeReason: Secret-Spreader is immediately understood. Timeline-goes-Underground is haunting and clear.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: undercover operative. Subject: bunny carrier passing invisible pathogen packet at crowded arena. Mood: covert menace.

cards.power: The Restoration. The Riot ends, Immune-Army returns to barracks. Weak-but-Winning.
cards.lore: Return-to-Baseline. Arena is repaired, but Fatigue-Tokens remain.
cards.gradeReason: Weak-but-Winning is a great post-match state. Fatigue-Tokens remaining is clinically and dramatically honest.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: post-battle cleanup. Subject: immune bunny soldiers limping back to barracks, arena scarred. Mood: exhausted victory.

cards.power: The Erosion. Joint-Space becomes Less-Rita-Reversible.
cards.lore: Mechanical failure over the Long-Timeline. The Arena Floor wears out.
cards.gradeReason: Less-Rita-Reversible is a great callback. Erosion as aging metaphor clear — needs long-timeline framing.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: time-worn stone. Subject: bunny wrestler joints visibly eroding over decades of matches. Mood: slow dignified decline.

cards.lore: Joint and Bone-Gears grind down after thousands of matches.
cards.gradeReason: Bone-Gears grinding is vivid. But without a POWER frame, this card only describes — doesn't invite.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: mechanical wear diagram. Subject: joint gears stripped to metal, grinding without lubrication. Mood: inevitable mechanical failure.

cards.power: Shortens the fuse until Retirement.
cards.lore: The Hayflick-Limit. A Maximum-Number of repairs allowed.
cards.gradeReason: Fuse-countdown is viscerally clear. Hayflick-Limit needs biology context to be more than a number.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: burning fuse countdown. Subject: DNA cap as fuse burning shorter with each cell division. Mood: measured countdown.

cards.power: The Junk-Build-Up. Arena-Clutter fills with cellular waste.
cards.lore: Clutter damages ability to function.
cards.gradeReason: Junk-Build-Up is relatable but the storage disease mechanism is too technical for non-med players.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: hoarding horror. Subject: cell arena filling with amyloid and lipofuscin junk piles. Mood: slow suffocation.

cards.power: The Story-Builder. Maps the Sequence-of-Events to identify the Antagonist's-Pattern.
cards.lore: History is 90% of Diagnosis. Time provides Logic-Flow that static labs miss.
cards.gradeReason: History-taking as superpower is true and important. But The Map is a tool, not a performer.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: detective timeline board. Subject: bunny doctor mapping disease events on cork board. Mood: methodical investigation.

cards.power: Distinguishes Hank-the-Hyper-Acute speed from Sarah-the-Sub-Acute speed.
cards.lore: Crucial for separating Chronic-Stable from Acute-on-Chronic-Crisis.
cards.gradeReason: Hank and Sarah as speed characters is a solid naming move. The Radar is a monitor, not a wrestler.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: clinical radar screen. Subject: bunny doctor reading velocity waves on spinning diagnostic display. Mood: alert pattern recognition.

cards.power: The Deadline-Enforcer. Alerts when the Sweet-Spot for an Intervention-Move is closing.
cards.lore: Monitors System-Performance against the Biological-Clock.
cards.gradeReason: Deadline-Enforcer naming is the right instinct. But The Watch observes — needs a wrestler embodiment.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: timekeeper officiating. Subject: bunny with stopwatch watching intervention window close on scoreboard. Mood: tense deadline.

cards.power: The Future-Viewer. Shows the Arena in 5 years if the Current-Timeline isn't altered.
cards.lore: Epidemiological-Data sets the expectations for the Long-Match.
cards.gradeReason: Future-Viewer is a great naming instinct. Epidemiological-Data as passive viewer — needs action frame.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: crystal ball epidemiology. Subject: bunny doctor gazing at 5-year disease trajectory in glowing orb. Mood: calm foresight.

cards.power: The Double-Assault. Hank-the-Hyper-Acute helps Chris-the-Chronic cause a Total-System-Crash.
cards.lore: A new Insult (Infection/Toxin) to an already Exhausted-Arena.
cards.gradeReason: Hank + Chris hitting an Exhausted-Arena — named characters in named collision. Zero setup needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: double-team ambush. Subject: two bunny wrestlers teaming on exhausted opponent in crumbling arena. Mood: overwhelming double strike.

cards.power: The Second-Round. The Enemy stops Hiding-in-the-Shadows for a Rematch.
cards.lore: Failure of Total-Eradication. The Timeline loops violently back to the Acute-Phase.
cards.gradeReason: Hiding-in-Shadows for a Rematch — enemy character with clear motivation. Immediate table performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: villain return. Subject: enemy pathogen emerging from shadows for round-two bell. Mood: menacing return.

cards.power: The On-Off-Switch. 100% fine, then sick. A series of Mini-Matches.
cards.lore: Intermittent-Failure. System is stable until a Trigger-Event causes temporary crash.
cards.gradeReason: On-Off-Switch with Mini-Matches is mechanically clear. Trigger-Event mechanics need disease context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: flickering light switch. Subject: bunny wrestler snapping between 100% and collapsed states. Mood: unpredictable interruption.

cards.power: The System-Meltdown. The fastest Timeline. Liver-Factory collapses before Diagnostic-Cards can be played.
cards.lore: Extreme virulence; zero host resistance. Sprint-to-the-End.
cards.gradeReason: Before Diagnostic-Cards can even be played — this card plays itself in spectacular fashion. Pure G1.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: rocket-fuel catastrophe. Subject: bunny wrestler disintegrating mid-sprint before any cards hit table. Mood: apocalyptic speed.

cards.power: Identify Timeline Position.
cards.lore: Deploy the Golden-Hour-Gabe rescue before Shock-the-Stumble locks in.
cards.gradeReason: Scenario mechanic is genuinely innovative. Needs full deck context — perfect capstone challenge card.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: emergency scenario card. Subject: clock showing SIRS-to-Shock timeline, bunny coach pointing at position. Mood: timed challenge.

cards.power: The Chrono-Coach.
cards.lore: Don't just treat the state; treat the rate! Stay fluffy!
cards.gradeReason: FrizzleBob IS the deck's mascot. Don't treat the state, treat the rate — the whole deck in one line.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: wise mentor portrait. Subject: FrizzleBob bunny in white coat holding stopwatch over timeline board. Mood: urgent wisdom.

cards.power: Explain Engine Failure.
cards.lore: Has the Window-of-Intervention for Lisino-the-Pril already... permanently closed?
cards.gradeReason: Lisino-the-Pril window closing is a great clinical tension. Scenario delivery is mechanically clever.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: engineering puzzle. Subject: heart engine blueprint with intervention window closing in red. Mood: diagnostic puzzle.

cards.power: Use Nomogram-Math.
cards.lore: Convince the wrestler that Ira-the-Irreversible is lurking and the Time-is-Brain clock is ticking!
cards.gradeReason: Convincing a 'fine' patient about lurking Ira is the hardest clinical sell. Scenario lands beautifully.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: ghost-warning showdown. Subject: bunny doctor showing TIA ghost to wrestler who feels 100%. Mood: urgent disbelief.

verdict: Disease Timelines is the deck that makes temporal pattern recognition feel like a sport. The sepsis cascade four-pack on page 4 is the best consecutive run this series has produced — SIRS to MODS plays like an unstoppable combo with no setup required. The clinical tools page (p.13) hits the brakes hard: The Map, The Radar, The Watch, and Natural-Course are all monitors, not wrestlers — four G3 cards that need persona transplants before the next print run. The Quest cards on page 15 are a genuinely smart innovation: scenario-as-card-mechanic that rewards learning the deck. Table-ready: Yes.
blurb: For med students who need to stop thinking 'disease state' and start thinking 'disease trajectory.' 56 cards covering sepsis cascades, HF staging, stroke windows, wound healing, and pharmacokinetics — all through the wrestling metaphor.

coverQA.coverVisual: 4 — FrizzleBob with timer/clock imagery over arena; dynamic and series-consistent
coverQA.coverTitle: 5 — 'Disease Timeline Wrestling: The Temporal Tide / Tipping Points & The Golden Hour' is genuinely punchy for med-ed
coverQA.coverVibeMatch: 5 — temporal urgency plus wrestling metaphor perfectly aligned, tagline earns its keep
coverQA.coverOriginality: 4 — stronger title differentiation than most MedKayfab covers; The Temporal Tide is a real identity
coverQA.coverViral: 4 — 'In the arena of life, the clock is the referee' is quotable and shareable within med-ed audiences
coverQA.coverNote: Best cover title in the MedKayfab series so far — The Temporal Tide and The Golden Hour do real work as twin hooks. The 'Don't just treat the state; treat the rate' / 'Stay fluffy' combo on the cover earns the whole deck. Visual would benefit from a visible timeline arc to reinforce the core concept.

notes: Image-based PDF; all text via OCR (pytesseract). Page 8 required enhanced contrast + 3x resolution re-render to extract text. Card names on p.2 (especially BL and BR) were partially unreadable — names reconstructed from context and subtitle text. P.5 TR compensated-HF card name unclear ('pilation P Reduced' OCR artifact). P.9 TL and TR card names inferred from POWER text (The Future-Shield / The Tactical-Strike). P.12 TL aging card name inferred. Notable deck features: (1) Sepsis page (p.4) is the standout — all 4 cards G1; (2) Clinical tools page (p.13) is the weakness — all 4 cards G3; (3) Quest scenario cards on p.15 are an innovative meta-mechanic unique to this deck; (4) 'Call Doc Frizzle!' callout boxes visible on p.6; (5) Doc FrizzleBob as named character card on p.15 anchors the deck's temporal attending persona; (6) Wound healing page (p.8) is a pleasant structural surprise — Inflam/Prolifer/Remodel/Chronic-Non-Healer tells a clean 4-act arc.
